header: What happens to study data after publication
content:
Authors deposit the data behind a Northstar paper before the proof stage. The dataset gets the same DOI prefix as the article. Authors can set an embargo of up to 24 months. After that, the files are public, versioned and citable on their own.

Consent records stay with the institution that collected them. The archive holds the analysis set, the codebook and the scripts that rebuild the published tables.
sidebar_content:
Deposit checklist

  • Analysis set and codebook
  • Scripts that rebuild every table
  • Embargo length, up to 24 months

Write to the data desk at data@northstarlabs.example. It replies within two working days.
